name: Flask + HTMX + SQLite
note: Each task runs a real command. Token figures are not recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost directly from the kit files.

eval_tasks.title: Application factory boots with WAL enabled
eval_tasks.instruction: The app factory must construct cleanly and the health endpoint must report SQLite running in WAL journal mode.

eval_tasks.title: HTMX dual-render and CRUD lifecycle
eval_tasks.instruction: A standard GET returns a full document; an HX-Request returns only the fragment. Create, toggle and delete must round-trip.
assertions: GET / returns a full HTML document
HX-Request returns a fragment with no <html> wrapper
create, toggle and delete all succeed

eval_tasks.title: Declared security controls hold under test
eval_tasks.instruction: Run the suite that exercises the controls named in security/checks.json with CSRF protection switched on.
assertions: tokenless POST, HTMX POST and DELETE are all rejected with 400
a CSRF token is rendered for HTMX to attach
security headers are present on every response
a quote-breaking search payload is treated as a literal
stored script payloads are HTML-escaped on render
WAL, foreign_keys and busy_timeout pragmas are enforced
.env.example contains no real secret and no BOM

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete functional and security suite must pass with no failures.
